📄 Iran’s Judiciary chief: Americans will not even dream of presence in Persian Gulf 📌 Tehran, IRNA — Judiciary Chief Gholamhossein Mohseni Eje’i, referring to the dominance of the Iranian Armed Forces from the east of the Strait of Hormuz to the northern Indian Ocean, says the Americans will no longer even dream of maintaining their presence or operating freely in the Persian Gulf. In a message posted on his social media account, marking the Iranian Army Navy Day on Saturday, Mohseni Eje’i said that the Persian Gulf remained under the control of the valiant warriors—loyal to Commander-in-Chief, Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei— from the Army and the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC). ​ Calling the Navy an important pillar and component of the deterrence and might of the country, he described the naval forces as brave-hearted guardians of the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz. ​ This divinely inspired and loyal force is tasked with safeguarding maritime authority and serves as the custodian of the pure blood of the sailors of the warships Joshan, Sahand, Sabalan and Dena, who were martyred in enemy attacks, said the Judiciary chief. ​ He underscored that Army sailors, standing shoulder-to-shoulder with the IRGC forces, confronted the arrogant aggressors and removed the sinister presence of the US from the Persian Gulf. ​ Hailing the victory of the Armed Forces over the enemies, Mohseni Eje’I also paid tribute to all the martyrs of the naval forces—from both the Army and the IRGC—and especially the proud martyrs of the Dena vessel. ​ The pure blood of our heroes stands as an enduring testament to their loyalty to the homeland, he added, in reference to 104 unarmed Dena sailors who were martyred on March 4, 2026, in international waters by a US Navy submarine, while returning from the multinational “Milan 2026” naval exercise in India. 📲 @Irna_en ​

Fwd from @ 📝 Political reshuffle 📝 The Chen Jining case reshapes personnel arrangements in the CCP Twenty years ago, Shanghai became the starting point for the rapid rise of China's current leader Xi Jinping . Now history may repeat itself, although the political conditions in the country have changed significantly. An investigation into Shanghai's municipal party committee secretary Chen Jining will almost inevitably lead to his resignation. This means that the balance of power is shifting ahead of major personnel reshuffles expected at the CCP's XXI Congress in 2027. The post of Shanghai's municipal party committee secretary is traditionally considered one of the most important steps in the careers of Chinese leaders. Of the last ten heads of the city, eight subsequently entered the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee, and two — Jiang Zemin and Xi Jinping — ultimately became the country's leaders. 🖍 The current situation resembles events in 2006, when the previous municipal party committee secretary Chen Liangyu was removed as a result of a corruption scandal. In March of the following year, Xi Jinping took the post. By October, he entered the Standing Committee of the Politburo, and in 2012 he became the supreme leader of the PRC. 🚩 However, personnel appointments in China have become less predictable . The Chinese leader himself is in no hurry to fill the vacant leadership positions until he determines his further priorities. ❗️ In any case, the candidacy of Shanghai's next party committee secretary will provide better insight into the balance of power within the CCP and Xi Jinping's plans for the upcoming personnel reshuffles. At the same time, in the current political system, this post carries not only career opportunities but also additional risks. #China 🏮 @rybar_pacific — your ticket to Pacific chaos 💸 Support us Original msg

ရန်ကုန်တိုင်းဒေသကြီး၌ အလုပ်အကိုင် ၄၅၀ ကျော် ဖန်တီးပေးမည့် ပြည်တွင်းပြည်ပရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံမှုလုပ်ငန်းသစ် ၃ ခု အတည်ပြု ရန်ကုန်၊ နိုဝင်ဘာ ၂၈ ရန်ကုန်တိုင်းဒေသကြီးအတွင်း ပြည်တွင်းအလုပ်အကိုင် အခွင့်အလမ်း ၄၅၈ ဦး ဖန်တီးပေးနိုင်မည့် စက်မှုကဏ္ဍ ၌ ပြည်တွင်းပြည်ပရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံမှုလုပ်ငန်းသစ် (၃) ခုကို ရန်ကုန်တိုင်းဒေသကြီး ရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံမှုကော်မတီက အတည်ပြုပေးလိုက်သည်။ ရန်ကုန်တိုင်းဒေသကြီး ရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံမှုကော်မတီ၏ (၅/၂၀၂၆) ကြိမ်မြောက် အစည်းအဝေးကို နိုဝင်ဘာ ၂၇ ရက်က ရန်ကင်းမြိုနယ်၊ တိုင်းဒေသကြီးရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံမှုကော်မတီရုံး၌ ကျင်းပစဉ် အတည်ပြုခဲ့ခြင်း ဖြစ်သည်။ အဆိုပါလုပ်ငန်းများတွင် စက်မှုကဏ္ဍတွင် နိုင်ငံခြားရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံမှုလုပ်ငန်း(၁)ခုနှင့် နိုင်ငံသားရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံမှုလုပ်ငန်း(၂)ခုတိုကို အတည်ပြုပေးခဲ့ခြင်းဖြစ်ပြီး အတည်ပြုပေးသည့်လုပ်ငန်းများမှာ စားသောက်ကုန်နှင့် အထည်ချုပ်လုပ်ငန်းများဖြစ်သည်။ အဆိုပါရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံမှုလုပ်ငန်းများ၏ မတည်ငွေရင်း ပမာဏမှာ အမေရိကန်ဒေါ်လာ ၂.၈၇၁ သန်းနှင့် မြန်မာကျပ်ငွေ ၂,၂၀၀ သန်း ဖြစ်သည်။
